meta.title: Sum Total reduced by a Fixed Value
gaps: Set or retain the vendor bid dropdown on Fixed Value in Cost Breakdown Mode.
Enter a fixed-value reduction and click Revise Bid.
Assert that the new current bid equals the original Sum Total minus the entered fixed value.
